entries.basis: Complete edited volume of fifteen linguistic studies, one of which directly studies biblical quotations in incantation bowls; it is not a finite bowl catalogue.
Complete printed pp. 147-170 chapter analyzing the phonological and reading-tradition evidence of biblical quotations across published Aramaic bowls.
Complete book includes Thomas Ellis's discussion and separate treatment of six numbered bowls on printed pp. 509-522, plus an unquantified group of fragments discussed collectively as no. 7.
Complete 1898-1899 volume publishes thirty separately numbered Khouabir bowl inscriptions with translations, commentary, plates, appendices, glossary, and index.
The supplied title and incomplete contents identify a multi-object edition, but the held seven-page file is only partial front matter and does not support object enumeration.
Complete seven-printed-page scholarly review of Juusola 1999; the file is not the reviewed monograph and contains no finite object catalogue.

Wajsberg's complete review describes a monograph-level analysis of the phonology, morphology, dialect mixture, and transmission of the Hebrew-square-script Aramaic bowl corpus through 1997. The monograph itself is not held.
